lines.arrive: The Festival of Summer, in the city of Omelas.
lines.happy: Everyone here is happy. Not foolishly, and not because they're told to be. They just are.
lines.knows: Everyone in Omelas knows about the door at the foot of the hall.
lines.not_yet: The festival has only just begun.
lines.flute: A boy plays the flute, alone, for anyone who stops to listen.
lines.horses: The horses have ribbons braided into their manes. They know it's a race day.
lines.cellar: Under one of the beautiful buildings, in the dark, a child sits alone.
lines.terms: The city's happiness, all of it, depends on this child staying here, in the dark.

terms_2.text: If it were brought up into the sunlight, and comforted, all of it would be lost. Those are the terms.

lines.ask: Now you know too. What will you do?
lines.back_up: You come back up into the sunlight. The music is still playing.
lines.stay_idle: The music plays on. You stay.
lines.stay_2: Most people who see the child are shocked. In time, most of them come to accept it.
lines.walk_1: You walk out of Omelas, alone, towards the mountains.

walk_2.text: Nobody knows where they go, the ones who walk away. They seem to be sure of the way.

lines.free_1: You carry the child up, into the sun.
lines.free_2: And the music stops. The colour goes out of everything. Those were the terms.
lines.free_3: One child is warm. And the rest of Omelas is not.
